results.excerpt: Her brother Ansel emigrated in 1960 and worked as a ship's engineer. They wrote to each other every month after they reconciled; she kept his letters in a biscuit tin.
Her advice on quarrels was never to go to bed on an argument you can end with a cup of tea. She did not speak to her brother Ansel for two years after their father's funeral and regretted it.
Tessaly Brackwen was born on 3 March 1941 in Hollin Reach, a harbour town. She was the younger of two children; her brother Ansel was four years older.
Their son Jory was born in 1969 and became a baker. His shop sells a saffron bun made to Tessaly's recipe.
In 2016 she moved from the house to a second-floor flat on Quay Street with a view of the harbour mouth. She took the ship's clock and the press and little else.
